title: Switzerland’s glaciers are losing an astonishing amount of ice. See the meltdown.
summary_full: Dry winters and a warming climate are taking a toll on centuries-old ice in the Alps, researchers say, with about 20 percent of Swiss glacial ice melting since 2021.
